user.title: Add a G-Web gate module
user.description: Paste a G-Web URL for your module, such as the MCRStatus or MCRActEn URL the G-Remote or MyCentsys Remote app calls. Its data parameter identifies the module and your account; it is stored in Home Assistant and not shown again.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the G-Web URL
reauth_confirm.description: G-Web no longer accepts the stored details. Paste a current G-Web URL for the same module.

error.invalid_url: That is not a G-Web URL with a data parameter holding a device ID and token.
error.invalid_auth: G-Web did not recognise that module and token.

abort.already_configured: This module is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That URL is for a different module.
